claims.claim: Nike Toronto Eaton Centre is an open Nike store downtown, used as a launch and drop-day door

sources.title: Nike Opens Canadian Flagship at CF Toronto Eaton Centre
nike toronto eaton centre store opening canadian flagship

claims.evidence: Nike opened a two-level Canadian flagship of about 21,000 sq ft in part of the former Nordstrom space at CF Toronto Eaton Centre in October 2025, replacing a smaller store in the mall. Retail Insider says Fox Group, Nike's Canadian licensee, operates it, so it is Nike-branded but licensee-run.
claims.action: No change needed. The store's operator (a licensee, not Nike directly) is noted here for whoever confirms 'Nike-owned' wording.

claims.claim: A Nike store at CF Yorkdale is open as a premium, draw and drop-day door

sources.title: nike opens massive flagship store at torontos yorkdale shopping centre

claims.evidence: A Nike flagship of about 25,000 sq ft opened at Yorkdale in August 2021, operated by Fox-Wizel. The results date from 2019 to 2021 and do not show whether it is still open in 2026.
claims.action: No change. Current status stays in the verify queue.

claims.claim: Toronto retired Vince Carter's #15 on Nov 2, 2024

sources.title: vince carters no 15 jersey retired by toronto raptors in mid game ceremony

claims.evidence: The Raptors retired Carter's No. 15 on Saturday, Nov 2, 2024, at halftime of a home game against Sacramento at Scotiabank Arena. He was the first Raptor to get the honour.

claims.claim: Black History Month in Canada came from Toronto MP Jean Augustine's 1995 motion
claims.evidence: Augustine moved a motion in the House of Commons on Dec 14, 1995 to recognize February as Black History Month. It passed unanimously, and the first national observance was February 1996.
